professionalSummary.text: Candidate has experience building training pipelines for learning-to-rank models in Python.
professionalSummary.witness: Machine learning engineer at Lumenwick (e-commerce search software), February 2022 to present, building the Python training pipeline for the gradient-boosted learning-to-rank model used by the retail search product.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains an offline evaluation harness with ranking metrics such as NDCG.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the offline evaluation harness, computing NDCG@10 and mean reciprocal rank on a frozen query set for every candidate model before it could be proposed for testing.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Designed and analyzed online A/B tests of ranking changes with the experimentation team.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the analysis plans for three A/B tests of ranking changes with the experimentation team, specifying the primary metric, sample size and stopping rule in advance.

skills.text: Monitors feature drift in the ranking feature store.
skills.witness: Added drift checks on the 40 most-used ranking features, alerting when the population stability index went above 0.2 for two consecutive days.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building training pipelines for learning-to-rank models, maintaining an offline evaluation harness, designing A/B tests, and monitoring feature drift. They do not establish the candidate's ability to set technical direction for the ranking roadmap or present trade-offs to product leadership.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide evidence for some requirements but not all. A qualified human review is required to make a hiring decision.
